enemy.name: Matters of Cooking
enemy.flavour_text: Scriptgeist born of the fire and smoke of kitchens, whose original name was 'Food'. In the Great Hunt a thousand years ago, the people worked their kitchens around the clock to supply the soldiers with food, giving them the courage to fight. Historians recorded this for posterity and archived it in Sky Mirror Pavilion.

abilities.text: Provides SP to friendly Operators when approaching them, then disappears
